sentences.text: In short: STØREN DYREKLINIKK AS is an established micro company in "veterinærtjenester" based in Midtre Gauldal, profitable in 2025 and with no open NAV job ads under its org number.
STØREN DYREKLINIKK AS describes itself on its website as: "Fra Onsdag 20.Mai og til Fredag 22.Mai har vi sterkt redusert vetrinærbemanning grunnet kursvirksomhet".
STØREN DYREKLINIKK AS is a private limited company (AS), founded on 2008-08-19, registered in Midtre Gauldal.
It has 8 registered employees, reported revenue of NOK 7.25M for 2025 and an operating result of NOK 243,740 (2025).
Its 2025 accounts show an operating margin of 3.4% and a moderate equity ratio of 31% of total assets.

Revenue rose 11.0% from 2024 to 2025 (NOK 6.53M to NOK 7.25M); it was NOK 6.73M in 2023. The annual result was a profit in each of the 3 filed years read (2023: NOK 622,952, 2024: NOK 178,627, 2025: NOK 176,300).
STØREN DYREKLINIKK AS is led by Pernille Birgitte Bratt Gustavsen, who is both CEO and board chair.
It has a board of 2. The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2026-06-09 (within the past year).
STØREN DYREKLINIKK AS has a verified website (https://storendyreklinikk.no/), 1 linked public profile and 1 registered workplace.
